newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady, bar easier lead, zinc.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady, bar easier lead, zinc.

text.p: Zinc and lead prices extended losses on the Indian market while other base metals stabilised at the lower levels recently established, dealers said.
Higher offerings by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd., which reduced selling prices for May, sent zinc and lead tumbling further.
Ready zinc slid by 50 rupees at 7,800 rupees while lead moved down by 100 rupees at 4,250 rupees per quintal.
Hindustan Zinc had lowered selling prices of zinc by 1,000 rupees and of lead by 4,000 rupees per tonne.
Copper was quiet at 13,500 rupees after losing 50 rupees per quintal on Monday.
Tin was indicated at the previous level of 31,200 rupees per quintal, so was nickel at 36,100 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
Aluminium was availabe at the steady level of 7,450 rupees per quintal but trading remained at a low ebb.
